result_revision.change_summary: Initial dev result for the released CarBench checkpoint.

methodology.record_note: Released CarBench checkpoint (carbench-weights-v1.0, tripnet.pt) run unchanged; every native surface point of all 1,154 official_test designs is predicted directly. Training compute is from the recorded run.

architecture.description: Triplane neural field: each design's geometry is encoded as a 3 x 32 x 128 x 128 triplane fitted to its surface occupancy with a shared 45,569-parameter occupancy decoder; a 7,919,393-parameter U-Net plus MLP head maps triplane features at any query point to pressure.

components.description: Triplane neural field: each design's geometry is encoded as a 3 x 32 x 128 x 128 triplane fitted to its surface occupancy with a shared 45,569-parameter occupancy decoder; a 7,919,393-parameter U-Net plus MLP head maps triplane features at any query point to pressure.

key_hyperparameters.name: geometry_fit_steps
key_hyperparameters.description: Per-design geometry fit steps at inference.

input_features.name: surface_geometry_occupancy
input_features.description: Occupancy of points sampled around each design's native surface, used only to fit its geometry triplane (no pressure).

input_features.name: query_coordinates
input_features.description: Native surface-point x/y/z, normalized to the design's bounding box.

predicted_fields.description: Kinematic gauge pressure (m^2/s^2) at every native surface point, denormalized with training-set mean and standard deviation.

data_handling.normalization: Targets normalized with training-split statistics inside the model pipeline; predictions are returned in m^2/s^2.
data_handling.preprocessing: Native surface read unchanged; no remeshing.
data_handling.sampling: Training: 200,000 query points per design per step. Inference: the design's triplane is fitted from surface occupancy (70 Adam steps), then every native point is queried directly.

stages.description: Supervised training on the official DrivAerNet++ training split with model selection on the official validation split.

procedure.description: Three stages: (1) joint fit of the occupancy decoder and 500 training-design triplanes, 500 epochs, binary cross-entropy; (2) per-design triplane fits with the frozen decoder, 70 epochs each; (3) U-Net + MLP pressure head trained 200 epochs on 5,819 training designs (Adam, lr 1e-3, batch 8 designs, 200,000 query points per design, MSE). Geometry fitting uses occupancy only, never pressure.

duration.description: Predictor epochs; geometry stages as described.

compute.measurement_notes: Run log results_from_scratch/tripnet/run_master.log: 2026-06-11 16:40 to 2026-06-13 09:06 (40.4 h wall). Stage 1: 789 min on one GPU; stage 2: about 156 min on each of three GPUs; predictor: 1,474 min on one GPU. The released file is byte-identical to tripnet_from_scratch.pt.

checkpoints.bytes_description: Raw bytes of tripnet.pt from the CarBench v1.0 weights release, loaded unchanged.
checkpoints.role: Exact loaded checkpoint for every prediction.
checkpoints.selection_rule: Lowest official-validation loss, selected before any test-case inference.

inference_compute.hardware: 1 x NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB shared with other inference processes
inference_compute.measurement_notes: Wall time from first to last prediction file. Ran concurrently with up to nine other inference processes across two GPUs. Includes VTK reading, preprocessing, all passes and serialization; excludes model loading and the FluidsBench evaluator.

note: Dev result for a released CarBench checkpoint; not owner-approved and not an official result.

evaluation.command: python scripts/drivaernetplusplus.py evaluate-entry tripnet-entry --output work/tripnet --resume && python scripts/drivaernetplusplus.py package --evaluation-root work/tripnet/evaluation --config package-config-tripnet.json --discretization-cases discretization-cases.jsonl --checkpoint carbench-tripnet=tripnet.pt --output submissions/drivaernetplusplus/drivaernetplusplus-carbench-tripnet-dev-v1
